statement: Choppin Efficiency gives up to 100% chance to gain logs per chop and later unlocks Multi-Log Drop Chance
Choppin Speed raises overall gains per hour
Do not put much emphasis on Choppin Speed until much later in the game
At World 3 you can use Choppin Speed to increase your printer sample size
Multi-Log Drop Chance gives more logs per swing and dramatically increases gains per hour
AFK Info tab shows how much you gain every hour
Logs per hour and EXP per hour are shown in AFK Info tab to see resource gain and leveling speed
Green bar at the bottom shows your percent chance to gain a log when chopping a tree
Goal is to get enough Choppin Efficiency to reach the 100% bar
After 100% the bar turns orange and shows 1x 2x up to 50x and 70x logs per swing as efficiency rises
Between multiplier break points like 2x-3x or 3x-4x extra efficiency gives nothing
If you cannot squeeze out more efficiency to the next break point go for more AFK Gain Rate instead
Ideal is to sit at 19.5 million efficiency
Stack AFK Gain Rate after 19.5 million until you reach 64.5 million efficiency then stop there until next break point
Witch Hat crafted in Anvil Tab 2 gives 10% Choppin Efficiency as helmet
Furled Robes crafted in Anvil Tab 2 give 10% Choppin Efficiency
Bleached Designer Wode Patch Pants crafted in Anvil Tab 1 give 5% Choppin Efficiency
Fibrous Footings from Anvil Tab 4 give 35% Choppin Efficiency
Logger Heels from Anvil Tab 2 give only 20% Choppin Efficiency compared to Fibrous Footings
Get the Fibrous Footings as soon as possible
Persephone's Bouquet from Dungeon Flurbo Shop gives 15% Skill AFK Gain Rate but costs many Flurbos so comes later
Serrated Rex Ring is crafted using Rex Rings from Flurbo Shop plus a recipe dropped by Baba Yaga; each gives 8% Skill Efficiency
Mystery Upgrade Stones have a chance to increase the misc bonus of the ring
Premium hat and ring can be upgraded with more Wisdom to give more Choppin Efficiency
Recommend trinkets with all AFK Gain Rates; alternatives are Diamond Honker for All Skill Speed or percent Wisdom
If you have nothing else use percent All Stats items but prefer AFK Gain Rate first
Use the highest level axe you can; need materials and the level requirement
Starfire Axe requires level 65 to use
Use latest World tool upgrade stones currently World 4 reaching 46 Choppin Power which correlates to more efficiency
No food directly increases Choppin Efficiency but a few are useful
Golden Ham increases skill EXP but be careful how much skill XP you gain because of a penalty
Saucy Log Fries crafted in Anvil Tab 1 give lots of Choppin Speed; expensive but have some for printer sampling
Chogg Nog gives lots of Choppin Speed but is consumed very fast; do not use regularly
Save Chogg Nog for 3D printer sampling to use it most efficiently
Recommend a Mage-based class such as Shaman or Bubonic Conjurer or Wizard for Choppin
Tab 1 first priority is Smart Efficiency for total efficiency of specialized skills
Next Active AFK'er to increase AFK Gain Rates
Next Book of the Wise to raise base Wisdom which gives Choppin Efficiency
Next Mana Booster because of an alchemy bubble giving efficiency from your mana
Tab 2 top priority Log on Logs which is an active ability needing to be on the action bar to boost tree drops
Leaf Thief gives Choppin Efficiency based on grass leaves in your storage chest
Deforesting All Doubt increases the effect Wisdom has on Choppin Efficiency
Does not really recommend Choppin It Easy but uses it for minigame rewards giving more EXP and drops
Next priority Individual Insight for base Wisdom or Untwisted Robes if gear is good enough
Next priority Mana Overdrive for large mana boost
Mana Overdrive boosts mana which increases Hocus Choppus bubble
Tab 3 Wis Wombo gives more max talent levels for Book of the Wise
Stupendous Statues increases the Lumberbomb statue bonus for Choppin Power
Occult Obols gives small Wisdom boost
Occult Obols is the very last priority as bonus is small
Earlier Education gives more Tab 2 talent points if needed
Spend extra points into alchemy bonuses since you are not doing much combat; top talents do not affect Choppin
Tab 4 Symbols of Beyond gives free talent levels to every talent with at least one level so free Skill Efficiency
Skill Wiz increases the effect Wisdom has on Skill Efficiency and gives small base Wisdom
Utmost Intellect gives percent Wisdom boost and raises max level of Book of the Wise
Family Guy gives small Wisdom boost from family bonuses such as Tab 2 total Wisdom bonus
Other talent points can go into Lab skills
First Star Talent priority is Tick Tock for AFK Gain Rate
Toilet Paper Postage Stamp gives small bonus based on level of stamps
A few points into Will of the Eldest for small Wisdom boost
Star Talents Tab 2 Super Source for more base Efficiency
Action Frenzy increases skill speed for Choppin and other skills
Frothy Malk boosts foods such as Saucy Log Fries
Likes Telekinetic Storage Printer Sampling and Shrine Architect on all characters but not necessary for efficiency
Hipster Logger star sign gives Choppin Efficiency and Multi-Log chance
Likes The OG Skiller for more Skill Prowess effect and Skill AFK Gain Rate
If not OG Skiller use The Big Comatose for Skill AFK Gain Rate
Hydron tab Comatose Major for more skill AFK Gain Rate
Wispommo alternative gives base Wisdom
First card priority Chaotic Troll for All Skill Efficiency
Amarok boss card gives skill AFK Gain Rate
Cubed Tree card gives Choppin Speed
Alien Tree card gives total Choppin Efficiency
Wispy Tree card gives Choppin Speed
Saharan Foal card gives AFK Gain Rate
Toilet Tree card gives Choppin Speed
Palm Tree card gives AFK Gain Rates
Card bonus choice is Easy Resources for Skill Efficiency or Hard Resources for Skill AFK Gain Rate
If between multi-log break points choose Hard Resources AFK Gain Rate over Efficiency because efficiency gives nothing right now
Hatchet Stamp gives base Choppin Efficiency
Chop and Bag Stamp gives carry capacity useful later
Duplogs Stamp gives Multi-Log Drop Chance
High IQ Lumber Stamp gives Choppin EXP but there can be a penalty if not careful
Swag Swingy Tool Stamp boosts Choppin Efficiency
Mana Stamp for base MP and Book Stamp and Arcane Stamp for base Wisdom
Feasty Statue gives food effect for a small Choppin boost
LumberBob statue gives Choppin Power
Golden Statues make statues account-wide so any character can spend on them
Stable Genius bubble gives base Wisdom
Mage is Best basically doubles purple bubbles but only while online on a Mage character
Hocus Choppus gives Choppin Efficiency from max MP and is one of the best alchemy benefits
Molto Loggo increases Multi-Log Drop Chance
NooDubble increases Choppin EXP gain
Le Brain Tools gives more skilling power from hatchets
SeveraPurple doubles bonuses of specific bubbles 1 and 3 which are big for Choppin so worth investing
Tree Sleeper gives Choppin AFK Gain Rate
Prowesessary reduces efficiency needed to reach multi-log chances so efficiency goes farther
Spanish Sahara vial increases Choppin Efficiency; costs many logs but worth investing though slow
Taped Up Timber box gives Chopping Efficiency Prowess effect and AFK Gain Rate
Mana Box is last priority for Choppin unless you have spare boxes
Myriad Crate gives base stats efficiency and EXP gain if you have leftover boxes
Utilitarian Capsule gives bonuses such as printer sampling size
Choppin Obols give Choppin Power and Wisdom
Without enough Choppin Obols stack base Wisdom; he gets only about 75 total Wisdom from obols
Skilled Dimwit prayer at Prayer Obelisk increases Skill Efficiency with big Skill EXP penalty
Recommend leveling Skilled Dimwit since efficiency is more useful than skill EXP especially with Maestro bonus
Balance of Proficiency is the opposite increasing Skill EXP at efficiency penalty useful for Maestro that levels skills slowly
Meal Corn gives big Skill Efficiency boost
Rice Ball meal gives more Skill Efficiency
Leek meal gives big Skilling Prowessary effect
Level Corn Rice Ball and Leek as soon as possible for skilling
Certified Stamp Book doubles bonuses from all stamps
My 1st Chemistry Stamp doubles bonuses from all alchemy vials
Emerald Navette Jewel gives base efficiency and skill speed and applies twice if all Green Jewels are active
Black Diamond Rhinestone boosts all Dinner Menu meal bonuses by about 24%
Red Chip in the middle increases Total Skill Efficiency for all skills
Red Chip middle row far right gives more base efficiency for all skills
Three Orange Chips bottom row double misc stats from trophy top keychain and pendant depending on equipment
Last two chips double the card bonus in the bottom right and top left card slots such as Chaotic Troll or Amarok
Right Hand of Action on Maestro gives huge Skill Efficiency bonus
At 100 talent points Right Hand of Action gives 75% skill efficiency to all characters
Maestro must have higher skill level than the other character; his Maestro 43 vs Shaman 49 so no benefit
Level up Maestro quite a bit to gain Right Hand of Action bonus
Use Left Hand of Learning if Maestro level is high enough for another big boost
Useful for leveling Choppin to use the next axe on your Shaman
